headline: Amateur Toft wins at Esbjerg by one shot
blurb: Amateur Daniel Toft from Smørum Golfklub won the Nicon Industries Championship by FREJA at Esbjerg Golfklub, finishing one shot ahead of William Gøth-Rasmussen and Carl Härdin.
body:
Amateur [Daniel Toft](/daniel-toft) won the Nicon Industries Championship by FREJA at Esbjerg Golfklub with a total score of 9 under par. The victory was close — just one shot separated Toft from the two players in shared second place.

[William Gøth-Rasmussen](/william-goth-rasmussen) and [Carl Härdin](/carl-hardin) both finished at 8 under par in a tie for second. Two more players ended at 7 under: [Albin Tidén](/albin-tiden) and [Christian Jacobsen](/christian-jacobsen), who shared fourth place.

The three-day tournament was played from September 9 to 11, with 115 players in the field. The cut fell at 3 over par, and 49 players made it through to the final round.

Toft plays out of Smørum Golfklub near Copenhagen. Winning a tour event as an amateur is rare, and he did it on a Danish course.
